newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico August retail sales fall, wholesale rises.
newsitem.headline: Mexico August retail sales fall, wholesale rises.

text.p: Mexico's retail sales fell 0.7 percent in August compared with the same month last year, the Mexican statistics institute INEGI said on Friday.
The institute said that wholesale sales rose by 0.9 percent in August compared to the same month a year earlier.
Wholesale sales increased in 18 cities, it said.
The INEGI report also said that purchases by retailers fell 0.5 percent in August over the same month a year earlier.
Purchases by wholesalers rose 10.3 percent in the same period, it said.
